## Focused software for people who run real businesses.

Kente HQ is a product studio in Ghana. We build small products that each do one job well, for customers worldwide.

### Five products, made to one standard.

Kente is woven in narrow strips, then sewn into one cloth. Each of our products is a strip: built for one kind of customer, with the same billing, privacy and support behind it.

#### Zoning Watchdog

Status: Live

For real estate investors

We read city planning agendas every hour and alert you when a rezoning, variance or special use matches your keywords, before the hearing.

Address: zoning.kentehq.com

#### Invoice Collector

Status: Live

For merchants in Ghana who sell on WhatsApp

Type an invoice in WhatsApp. Your customer gets a pay link, polite reminders every 48 hours and a receipt, and pays in cedis through Paystack.

Address: invoices.kentehq.com

#### No-Show Recovery

Status: Live

For US dental practices

When a patient cancels, text the opening to your waitlist in one tap. The first patient to reply YES is booked, and everyone else is told it was taken.

Address: dental.kentehq.com

#### Gatekeeper

Status: Live

For creators doing sponsor deals

Sponsors review watermarked previews, sign your terms and fund escrow in cedis through Paystack. The clean files unlock when the money lands.

Address: creator.kentehq.com

#### Gift Ledger

Status: Live

For Shopify brands that gift product to creators

Follow every PR gift from Shopify order to delivery to the creator's post, and see what each verified post cost you.

Address: gifts.kentehq.com

### How Zoning Watchdog works

Our first product, in four steps.

1. **Create a free account.** Sign up at [zoning.kentehq.com](https://zoning.kentehq.com). There is a free plan, so you can try it before paying.

2. **Add your keywords.** Tell Zoning Watchdog the words that matter to your deals.

3. **We read the agendas.** Every hour, Zoning Watchdog reads city planning agendas as they are posted.

4. **You hear first.** When a rezoning, variance or special use item matches your keywords, you get an alert before the hearing.

### How we work

The same rules apply to every product.

**Billing:** Four products have a free plan, and No-Show Recovery starts with a 14-day free trial. Paid plans are monthly or yearly subscriptions in US dollars, processed by Dodo Payments as merchant of record, and you can cancel any time from your account.

**Your data:** We collect only what each product needs to work, never sell it, and delete it when you close your account. Hosting is on our own servers in the European Union.

**Support:** Questions, support or partnerships. We reply within one business day. support@kentehq.com

**Where we are:** Kente HQ is a trading name of Accidental Genius LTD, a company registered in Ghana. We serve customers worldwide.

**Policies:** [Privacy policy](https://kentehq.com/privacy) · [Terms of service](https://kentehq.com/terms) · [Refund policy](https://kentehq.com/refunds)

### Questions

Plain answers about Kente HQ, our products, billing and your data. Anything else: support@kentehq.com.

#### What is Kente HQ?

Kente HQ is a software studio based in Accra, Ghana that builds small, focused web apps for small businesses. It runs five products, each on its own kentehq.com subdomain and each built for one kind of customer. Kente HQ is a trading name of Accidental Genius LTD, a company registered in Ghana.

#### Who are Kente HQ products for?

Kente HQ builds for people who run small businesses and want one job done well rather than a large suite of tools: real estate investors with Zoning Watchdog, merchants in Ghana who sell on WhatsApp with Invoice Collector, US dental practices with No-Show Recovery, creators doing sponsor deals with Gatekeeper, and Shopify brands that gift product to creators with Gift Ledger.

#### Which Kente HQ products are available today?

All five are live and run in the browser: Zoning Watchdog at zoning.kentehq.com, Invoice Collector at invoices.kentehq.com, No-Show Recovery at dental.kentehq.com, Gatekeeper at creator.kentehq.com and Gift Ledger at gifts.kentehq.com.

#### What does Zoning Watchdog do?

Zoning Watchdog reads city planning agendas every hour and alerts real estate investors when a rezoning, variance or special use item matches their keywords. The alert arrives before the hearing, so you hear about it while there is still time to act. It runs in the browser at zoning.kentehq.com and has a free plan.

#### How does Zoning Watchdog compare to checking agendas yourself or using Google Alerts?

Checking agendas yourself means visiting each city's website, opening every new agenda and reading it for items that matter, which costs nothing but takes time and is easy to miss. Google Alerts is free and useful for news, but it reports pages after Google indexes them rather than reading each agenda as it is posted. Zoning Watchdog does the agenda reading every hour and only alerts you on rezoning, variance and special use items that match your keywords.

#### What does Invoice Collector do?

Invoice Collector is for merchants in Ghana who sell on WhatsApp. You type an invoice in WhatsApp, and your customer gets a pay link, polite reminders every 48 hours and a receipt. Customers pay in Ghana cedis (GHS) through Paystack, and it works in Ghana only. It runs at invoices.kentehq.com and has a free plan.

#### What does No-Show Recovery do?

No-Show Recovery is for dental practices in the United States. When a patient cancels, you text the open slot to your waitlist in one tap; the first patient to reply YES is booked, and everyone else is told it was taken. It runs at dental.kentehq.com and starts with a 14-day free trial, no card needed.

#### What does Gatekeeper do?

Gatekeeper is escrow for creators doing sponsor deals. Sponsors review watermarked previews, sign your terms and fund escrow in Ghana cedis (GHS) through Paystack, and the clean files unlock when the money lands. It runs at creator.kentehq.com and has a free plan.

#### What does Gift Ledger do?

Gift Ledger is for Shopify brands that gift product to creators. It follows every PR gift from Shopify order to delivery to the creator's post, and shows what each verified post cost you. It runs at gifts.kentehq.com and has a free plan.

#### How much do Kente HQ products cost?

Plan prices are in US dollars and renew monthly or yearly until you cancel. Zoning Watchdog: Scout is free, Investor is $49 a month or $490 a year, and Desk is $199 a month. Invoice Collector: Starter is free for 10 invoices a month, and Shop is $9 a month or $90 a year. No-Show Recovery: Front desk is $99 a month and Whole practice is $179 a month per location, with a 14-day free trial and no card needed. Gatekeeper: Solo is free with a 5% platform fee per funded deal, and Pro is $19 a month or $190 a year with a 2% fee. Gift Ledger: Starter is free for 25 gifts a month, Growth is $79 a month or $790 a year, and Scale is $199 a month. We give 30 days' notice before a price changes.

#### Who processes payments for Kente HQ?

Dodo Payments is the merchant of record for Kente HQ subscriptions. That means Dodo Payments runs checkout, takes the payment and handles sales tax or VAT, and its terms apply to your purchase alongside ours. Money that moves inside a product is separate: Invoice Collector customers pay merchants, and Gatekeeper sponsors fund deals, in Ghana cedis through Paystack.

#### Can I cancel a Kente HQ subscription or get a refund?

You can cancel any Kente HQ subscription at any time from your account and keep access until the end of the period you paid for. If you were charged by mistake or the product did not work for you, email support@kentehq.com within 14 days of the charge for a full refund. Refunds go back to the original payment method through Dodo Payments, usually within 5 to 10 business days.

#### How does Kente HQ handle my data?

Kente HQ collects only what each product needs to work, does not sell personal data and does not use it for advertising. Data is hosted on our own servers in the European Union. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymise your data within 30 days, except records the law requires us to keep, such as invoices.

#### Which countries and currencies does Kente HQ support?

Kente HQ is based in Ghana and sells to customers worldwide. Subscription prices are in US dollars, and Dodo Payments handles checkout and local tax as merchant of record. Some products are built for one place: Invoice Collector works in Ghana only, Gatekeeper deals are paid in Ghana cedis, No-Show Recovery is for US dental practices, and Zoning Watchdog covers the cities whose agendas it reads.

#### How do I contact Kente HQ?

Email support@kentehq.com for support, billing questions or partnerships. We reply within one business day.

## About Kente HQ

Kente HQ is a product studio based in Accra, Ghana, and a trading name of Accidental Genius LTD, a company registered in Ghana. We build small, focused software products for people who run real businesses, and sell them to customers worldwide.

### Why the name

Kente cloth is woven in narrow strips on a loom, then the strips are sewn edge to edge into one cloth. Each strip has its own pattern, and the cloth only works because they are made to the same standard.

That is how we build. Each product is a strip: it does one job for one kind of customer and lives on its own subdomain. Behind all of them sit the same billing, privacy and support.

### What we make

All five products are live:

[Zoning Watchdog](https://zoning.kentehq.com), for real estate investors: reads city planning agendas every hour and alerts you when a rezoning, variance or special use item matches your keywords, before the hearing.

[Invoice Collector](https://invoices.kentehq.com), for merchants in Ghana who sell on WhatsApp: type an invoice in WhatsApp, and your customer gets a pay link, reminders and a receipt, paying in Ghana cedis through Paystack.

[No-Show Recovery](https://dental.kentehq.com), for US dental practices: text a cancelled slot to your waitlist in one tap, and the first patient to reply YES is booked.

[Gatekeeper](https://creator.kentehq.com), for creators doing sponsor deals: escrow where sponsors review watermarked previews, sign your terms and fund the deal in Ghana cedis through Paystack before the clean files unlock.

[Gift Ledger](https://gifts.kentehq.com), for Shopify brands that gift product to creators: follows each PR gift from Shopify order to delivery to the creator's post.

See [all five products](https://kentehq.com/#products), [how Zoning Watchdog works](https://kentehq.com/#how-it-works) and [common questions](https://kentehq.com/#faq).

### How we run them

Four products have a free plan, and No-Show Recovery starts with a 14-day free trial. Paid plans are monthly or yearly subscriptions in US dollars. Payments are processed by Dodo Payments as merchant of record. We collect only what each product needs, never sell it, and delete it when you close your account. Read the [privacy policy](https://kentehq.com/privacy), [terms](https://kentehq.com/terms) and [refund policy](https://kentehq.com/refunds).

### Company

Kente HQ is a trading name of Accidental Genius LTD, registered in Ghana. Accidental Genius LTD operates every Kente HQ product and is the party to our [terms of service](https://kentehq.com/terms).

### Contact

Questions, support or partnerships: support@kentehq.com. We reply within one business day.

## Privacy policy

Last updated 4 October 2026. Each product also publishes its own policy with product-specific details.

Accidental Genius LTD (trading as Kente HQ), a company registered in Ghana, operates Invoice Collector, No-Show Recovery, Gatekeeper, Gift Ledger and Zoning Watchdog. This policy explains what we collect across them.

### What we collect

Account details (name, email), the data you put into a product to make it work (for example invoices, waitlists, deliverables or keyword alerts), billing records from our payment processor, and basic technical logs to keep the service secure.

### How we use it

Only to run the product you signed up for, support you, bill you, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising.

### Who processes it

Hosting on our own servers in the European Union; email by Resend; subscription billing by Dodo Payments; in-product payments by Paystack where a product offers them; messaging by Meta (WhatsApp) or Twilio where a product sends messages; file storage by Cloudflare; product analytics by Mixpanel (EU). Each receives only what it needs.

### Product analytics

If analytics is enabled, we use Mixpanel (hosted in the European Union) to understand which pages and products people look at. We record page views, clicks on product cards and buttons, and outbound links, with an anonymous identifier stored in a first-party cookie on kentehq.com and our product subdomains. URLs are trimmed to the path plus utm_ and ref parameters. We do not record form input or sessions, we do not sell this data or use it for advertising, and we honour your browser's Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals by not tracking at all.

### Retention and deletion

We keep your data while your account is open. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymise it within 30 days, except records we must keep by law, such as invoices.

### Your rights

You can access, correct, export or delete your data. Email support@kentehq.com and we will respond within 30 days.

## Terms of service

Last updated 4 October 2026. Each product also publishes its own policy with product-specific details.

These terms are an agreement between you and Accidental Genius LTD (trading as Kente HQ), a company registered in Ghana. They apply to every Kente HQ product. By creating an account you agree to them.

### Your account

Keep your login secure and give accurate information. You are responsible for activity on your account and for having the right to any data you upload or messages you send through our products.

### Acceptable use

Do not use our products for spam, fraud, unlawful content, or to message people who have not agreed to hear from you. We may suspend accounts that put our users or providers at risk.

### Plans and billing

Paid plans renew monthly or yearly until cancelled. Dodo Payments is the merchant of record for subscriptions, and its terms also apply to your purchase. Prices may change with 30 days' notice.

### Availability

We work hard to keep the products running but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. To the extent the law allows, our liability is limited to the fees you paid in the previous 12 months.

### Contact

support@kentehq.com

Last updated 4 October 2026. Each product also publishes its own policy with product-specific details.

You can cancel any time from your account; you keep access until the end of the paid period. If you were charged by mistake or the product did not work for you, email us within 14 days of the charge and we will refund it in full.

### How refunds are paid

Refunds go back to the original payment method through Dodo Payments, usually within 5 to 10 business days.
